title: Page 224
transc:
Cipher Clerk Cairo  Washn 1230 pm Novr 7th 1864 
Grapes viola postpone for Neptune Mound City peasant
Bleaching zebra Be pleased to direct polkers in
your squadron to make all important signals by
adding a number utopia (toby designated in your 
order utopia) to signal numbers made and subtracting
the same number from signal numbers received webster
BF Greene chf clerk for chf Bureau


John Horner N. Y.  Washn 1 pm Novr 7th 1864
Harriet postpone for Knox zodiac The order of
Kunkle placing Ewen polka torch whisky seems to
me toby sufficient for the emergency ---- Is there
any particular advantage toby derived from assigning your
pontiac to any geographical district? The details 
torch pontiac and the proper field of your
opr rations can better be determined on the
spot blithe polking shelter andy have no doubt
that Kasson will arrange them in accordance with
your wishes and the best interest torch service
(Brutus)
